findings.finding: The named fix seam `max_output_cfg` only RAISES max_tokens toward the model cap and never lowers it, so for the default config (max_tokens=16000) a Nova cap of 10000 leaves the request at 16000 and Bedrock still 400s — the plan's stated fix does not actually clear the ValidationException on the seam it names.
scenarios: An operator running Bedrock Nova with the default (or any >10000) configured max_tokens: review calls go through max_output_cfg unchanged at 16000 and Bedrock rejects with 'exceeds the model limit of 10000'
findings.suggested_fix: Change max_output_cfg to clamp toward the model ceiling in BOTH directions (raise up to cap when below, lower down to cap when the configured max_tokens exceeds the provider hard limit), or add an explicit downward clamp for provider hard ceilings; and add an AC that exercises max_output_cfg (not just model_max_output_tokens) with a default-config LLMConfig on a Nova model, asserting the resulting max_tokens == 10000.
